title: India’s agrivoltaic capacity is expected to be more than 5-gigawatts in next 3-4 years: MNRE Secretary
description: “It is difficult to estimate but it should be upwards of 5-gigawatts in the next 3-4 years. It depends on state’s enthusiasm, ability to quickly notify a feed-in tariff,” said Union Ministry of New and Renewable Energy Secretary Santosh Sarangi
